docs.text:
# Weekly Google + LLM visibility — UniPrep2Go (FINRA + portfolio winner patterns)

**Repo:** `marfa77/uniprep2go` · **branch:** `main` · **site:** https://uniprep2go.study  
**Cron:** `0 9 * * 1` · **Model:** Grok 4.6 · **Ship:** push `main` (Vercel) + Telegram DM every run

Primary money market: **US FINRA ladder** (SIE → Series 7 → Series 63). Traffic is still near-zero in GSC top3 — every edit chases indexation + CTR that converts free mock → Anki/Gumroad.

## Cross-project winner patterns (apply lazily)

Steal **snippet structure**, not niche copy:

| Source | What wins | UniPrep transfer |
|--------|-----------|------------------|
| **Prep2Go** | Exam acronym + concrete need + year (`dtz exam dates 2026`, `dele a2 audio`, `ciple exam results`) → real clicks | Titles lead with `SIE` / `Series 7` / `Series 63` + action (practice test, fail rate, format) + `2026` |
| **PixID** | Specific offer in blue link (near you, $4.99, walk-in, 75Q chart) even at #1–3 | Put **Free / No signup / NQ timed / instant report** in title+meta — not vague “readiness check” |
| **Portfolio rule** | Max 3 URLs/cycle; one primary lever; skip pages in recheck window | Same |

Do **not** copy passport/local intent onto FINRA pages.

## Cloud Agent prerequisites (blocking)

1. Cloud Environment for this repo + secrets: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` (Pavel DM), `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON`, `GSC_SITE_PROPERTY=sc-domain:uniprep2go.study`.
2. Secrets gate: missing OpenRouter → ABORT. Missing GSC → continue with audits + prior briefs; do not invent GSC numbers.
3. After **every** run (including no-op): Telegram DM with winners watchlist, URLs touched, commit SHA, deploy yes/no, index status of money URLs, recheck date.

## US money surfaces (edit these only)

| Priority | URL | Money path |
|----------|-----|------------|
| P0 | `/mock-exams/sie-full-mock` | → SIE deck |
| P0 | `/mock-exams/series-7-readiness-check` | → Series 7 deck |
| P0 | `/mock-exams/series-63-readiness-check` | → Series 63 deck |
| P0 | `/decks/sie-exam-anki-deck`, `/decks/series-7-anki-deck`, `/decks/series-63-anki-deck` | Gumroad |
| P0 | Existing FINRA blogs only | → mock → deck |

**Frozen:** USCIS, EU citizenship, languages, LEED/building, CDL, PTCB, ServSafe, GRE/SAT/GMAT, CA RE / insurance expansion, new pages/SKUs.

## Hard rules

1. Max **3** page copy edits (title/meta/headline/intro/FAQ). One primary lever per URL.
2. Prefer URLs that are **indexed or discovered** — if SIE mock is still “Discovered not indexed”, strengthen internal links from homepage/finance hub + run `npm run indexnow:submit` after deploy; do not invent new blogs to “fix” indexation.
3. Ship to **prod**: commit + push `main` (or merge green PR same day). One ship / UTC week.
4. English UI only. Do not invent official FINRA pass rates.
5. If no safe FINRA edit → “no safe SIE/7/63 edits” + Telegram watchlist. Never fall back to USCIS/building.

## Weekly procedure

1. `npm run audit:seo:rules` && `npm run audit:aeo` (optional `audit:visibility:rules`)
2. If GSC works: pull `sc-domain:uniprep2go.study` → `docs/seo-weekly/YYYY-MM-DD-brief.md` including index status of P0 URLs
3. Build pattern cards from Prep2Go/PixID lessons above + any UniPrep query that got impr
4. Edit ≤3 allowlisted FINRA surfaces for CTR/index clarity
5. Append run log to `docs/SEO_AUTOPILOT_STRATEGY.md`
6. `npm test` (targeted OK) + `npm run build` if affordable
7. Push `main` → Vercel; `npm run indexnow:submit`
8. Telegram DM (required)

## Prompt (automation body)

```
UniPrep2Go — weekly FINRA SEO → prod + Telegram DM.

Goal: index + rank SIE / Series 7 / Series 63 money URLs using Prep2Go (exam+need+year) and PixID (specific free/NQ/no-signup offer) snippet patterns. Convert to free mock → Anki/Gumroad.

Secrets: OPENROUTER_API_KEY required. TELEGRAM_* required for DM. GSC optional but preferred.

HARD: FINRA allowlist only; max 3 URLs; one lever each; no new pages/SKUs; push main + IndexNow; Telegram every run including no-op.

STEPS:
1) audit:seo:rules + audit:aeo
2) GSC brief if keys present — note index status of /mock-exams/sie-full-mock and Series 7/63 + decks
3) Pattern cards → pick ≤3 peers/gaps
4) Point edits in mock-exams/seo.ts, deck-seo.ts, existing FINRA blogs only
5) Log docs/SEO_AUTOPILOT_STRATEGY.md
6) npm test (touched) → commit → push main → indexnow:submit
7) Telegram DM: index status, URLs, levers, SHA, recheck +14d

Reply with the same summary.
```

**Lock (2026-10-04):** Wave 1 = PTCB 40 · Series 63 40 · CFA L1 40. Refresh existing CFA L2 LITE (50) listing; do not upload a second L2. Skip language/civic LITEs (0–3 downloads measured).

docs.title: Cert / wave ship handoff (keep it fast)
docs.text: --- description: Fast cert/wave ship handoff — write once, review, screenshots, publish alwaysApply: true --- # Cert / wave ship handoff (keep it fast) User workflow (do not invent a slower one): 1. **Writer (this chat)** — one pass: bank expand once → apkg once → Gumroad create/assets → SEO/GEO wire → focused tests → gate script → **STOP** 2. **Bank content review (mandatory)** — fix-first subagent. Default **`gpt-5.6-sol-medium`** (cheaper). Escalate **`claude-opus-5-thinking-high`** on P0 remap/contamination, first live start on never-ledgered SKU, or user asks Opus. Never Grok. See `mock-bank-review-model.mdc`. No second full bank rewrite unless content P0. 3. **Sample screenshots (agent renders, not the user)** — `npm run refresh:sold-samples -- --slug {deckSlug}` → `npm run render:sample-shots -- --slug {deckSlug}` (review PNGs) → `--write --publish` puts `public/samples/{deckSlug}-sample-{1,2,3}.webp` + matching `decks.ts` sampleCards, then runs the Gumroad publisher for the deck type (wave `--polish-only`, building landings, finance polish, authored landing) + `check:gumroad-sample-cdn`, so Gumroad gets gallery **and** custom landing **Sample cards body** (not cover-only / site-only). Publisher table: `mock-bank-audit-standard.mdc` §5 4. **Publish** — commit/push only after user OK; `llms:export` already done in step 1 ## Path picker | SKU type | Spec / catalog | Apkg | Gumroad | Gate | |----------|----------------|------|---------|------| | Building cert | `building-deck-specs` + `certifications/registry` | `building_deck_pipeline` | `setup:gumroad-building-decks` | `npm run validate:certification -- --deck {slug}` | | Wave / niche | `wave-deck-specs` + `wave-anki-decks.json` | `wave_deck_pipeline` | `setup:gumroad-wave-decks` | `npm run validate:wave-deck -- --slug {slug}` | ACE CPT, Luxembourg Vivre ensemble, and most health/CDL SKUs are **wave**, not building registry. ## Classic Gumroad page first (user, 2026-10-02) Buyers find us through Gumroad Discover search, which shows the **classic product page**. Do **not** build new custom landings (`products page publish`). Selling power goes into: title + tags/category (Discover ranking), `custom_summary`, rich HTML description from `src/data/gumroad/landing-copy.json` (validator: `scripts/landing-copy-validate.py`), and 3 real sample screenshots in the `--preview-image` gallery. Existing custom landings stay until the user decides to clear them (`gumroad products page clear`). The landing steps below are legacy. ## Gumroad product (always — hard gate) Every published Anki SKU must have on Gumroad: 1. **Rich HTML description** (exam context, what's inside, FAQ, disclaimer, site/mock links) 2. **3 sample screenshots in the product body** via custom landing Sample cards (`publish-wave-gumroad-landings.py` / building equivalent) — Gumroad strips `` from default description 3. Gallery previews via `--preview-image` (wave polish also uploads these) **Phase C is incomplete until polish-only succeeds** (description + gallery + landing body). Site webps alone are not enough. Wave: ```bash # after render:sample-shots --write produced public/samples/{slug}-sample-{1,2,3}.webp npm run setup:gumroad-wave-decks -- --slug {slug} --polish-only # (calls publish-wave-gumroad-landings.py for Sample cards in product body) ``` Building: `polish-building-gumroad.py` + `publish-building-gumroad-landings.py`. Do not leave a live Gumroad product with thin one-paragraph copy and cover-only images. ## Gumroad sample CDN (403 guard) After `--polish-only`, cover cleanup, or any Gumroad asset change, run: ```bash npm run check:gumroad-sample-cdn ``` If broken: re-publish landings with `--force-cdn` on the matching script (`publish-building-gumroad-landings.py`, `publish-wave-gumroad-landings.py`, `publish-language-gumroad-landings.py`). Exit code 1 = at least one `public-files.gumroad.com` sample URL is stale (usually HTTP 403). ## Speed rules - Do **not** mix unrelated audits (Danish, PTCB, planned P0, …) into the active ship - Expand bank **once**; regenerate apkg/assets only after a real content fix from review - Do **not** invent blank/identical sample webps or mock up card text — samples come only from `render:sample-shots` on the shipped `.apkg` - GEO in the same writer pass: exam-facts + commercial cite / one-liner + money-page + `npm run llms:export` - After writer gate is READY (0 fails), hand to review immediately — do not keep polishing for hours - Skill detail: `.cursor/skills/add-certification/SKILL.md`

description: Competitor AEO live-pass cadence — do not re-audit weekly

---

# Competitor AEO cadence (2 months)

When the user pastes growth-pulse / Top pages / Google / LLM traffic:

1. Read `docs/mock-bank-qa/competitor-aeo-ledger.md` **before** starting a competitor SERP pass.
2. If a slug’s **last competitor AEO** is **< 60 days** ago: do **not** re-run WebSearch SERP or rewrite cites. Report “fresh until {date}” and only inspect bank/Gumroad if the user asked about a live mock start or a P0.
3. Re-audit (full bank + GEO + competitor) only when:
   - last pass is **≥ 60 days**, or
   - SKU is **new / never ledgered**, or
   - user explicitly asks, or
   - P0 content / official-facts drift (wrong Q count, time, pass score)
4. After a pass, **update the ledger** (date + one-line beat/gap). Do not invent weekly re-audits from pulse repeats.
5. If mock ↔ Anki are linked, the pass covers **both** URLs — same date / next_ok; beat/gap notes must mention mock + deck. Cadence “fresh until” applies to the pair, not one side alone.

Homepage `/` is a hub — not a SKU audit.

Existing live-pass docs (ACSM, ASHRAE, NEBOSH, WELL, wave-31, Luxembourg ship) count as the last pass for those slugs.

# GSC crawled – not indexed → strengthen now

When URL Inspection (or a batch recheck) returns **Crawled - currently not indexed** for a UniPrep `/decks/*` or `/mock-exams/*` money URL:

## Do (same turn)

1. Open the live page + `decks.ts` / `deck-seo.ts` / `deck-money-page-content.ts` (or mock landing equivalents).
2. **Unique content first** — expand money-page / study-guide copy so it is not a near-duplicate of sibling SKUs (language family decks are the usual fail).
3. Tighten `seo_title` / description / `directAnswer` / FAQs with concrete exam facts, audience, and “what this is not”.
4. Bump `lastUpdated` on real content change; run focused tests; `npm run llms:export` if facts/cites change.
5. Commit/push only when the user asks to ship.

## Do not

- Ignore crawled-not-indexed and only wait for another GSC recheck.
- Copy-paste another language sibling’s money block with a demonym swap.
- Invent official exam Q-counts or pass scores.

## Related

- Discovered / unknown → usually wait + re-request; still strengthen if the page is thin.
- Competitor AEO: `competitor-aeo-cadence.mdc` + ledger (skip SERP rewrite if < 60 days unless user asks).

docs.text:
# Ideal selling samples on language deck rebuild

When rebuilding a Prep2Go / Anki language deck from the app DB (export → drop-crooked → apkg → Gumroad → UniPrep):

## Do not

- Use the first 3 CSV rows (`be` / `i` / `you` or L1 equivalents). Frequency order ≠ selling samples.
- Ship stamp leftover examples as previews.
- Skip visual check of the three JPGs before `--apply` / Gumroad `--force-cdn`.

## Do

1. After `source.csv` is final, run:

```bash
python3 scripts/select-ideal-language-samples.py \
  --deck-dir "/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/Anki Generator/out/prep2go_<Deck>" \
  --shop-key <ShopPreviewKey> \
  --slug <uniprep-slug> \
  --print-top 20
```

2. Visually confirm 3 picks (image matches headword; not wrong sense). Prefer theme mix: education + work + daily for IELTS EN-* decks.
3. Apply:

```bash
python3 scripts/select-ideal-language-samples.py ... \
  --picks word1,word2,word3 --apply
```

4. Update Gumroad landing `sample_captions` if needed; `--force-cdn` + site sample webps.

## Ideal-sample criteria (summary)

Hard: media present, clean bilingual example, headword in target sentence, not function/basic lemma, no stamp templates.  
Soft: mid-frequency, concrete/visualizable, noun gloss cues, larger image.  
Diversity: distinct themes for the SKU story (not three near-synonyms).

Full rules live in the script docstring.

docs.title: Live mock start inspection
docs.text:
---
description: Live mock:start traffic — bank + GEO + competitor AEO checklist
alwaysApply: true
---

# Live mock start inspection

When the user pastes a UniPrep2Go `mock:…:start` / “Mock started” signal (or asks to inspect a live mock path), run this **same pass every time**. Do not stop at bank/Gumroad only.

## Linked mock ↔ Anki pair (hard rule)

If the SKU has a linked pair (`linkedDeckSlug` on the mock **or** `mockSlug` on the deck/spec), **always apply audit results to both pages in the same pass**:

- `/mock-exams/{mockSlug}` — title / meta / H1 / intro / FAQ / official-format honesty / hub link / high-intent mock block
- `/decks/{deckSlug}` — money-page pitch + unique content / directAnswer–FAQ honesty / commercial cite (when live) / exam-facts map

Do **not** ship GEO/SERP fixes on only the traffic URL. Ledger both slugs (or one row that names both). Planned Anki still gets honesty + mock CTA; live Anki gets money-page + cite.

## Mandatory layers (all three)

### 1) Bank / product pathway
- Smell triage (`npm run triage:mock-banks -- --slug {mockSlug}` or equivalent)
- Correct gate: `validate:certification` (building) or `validate:wave-deck` (wave)
- Session size vs official exam note, key bias, template stems, sample cards, Gumroad polish/landing if selling
- **Bring to session/bank standard** (same pass, not a later ticket): wave default **60Q session** with unique bank **≥120** (min 90) so Mock Pass retakes are not the same 60 stems shuffled; money SKUs 75–120 official-adjacent when the bank exists; always honest vs official CAT/Q/time. Do not inflate to 200+ volume. See `mock-bank-audit-standard.mdc` § Session / bank size.
- **Content review (mandatory if never ledgered, remap smell, Wave-3 "This item asks" pads, or triage misses credential match):** fix-first subagent — default `gpt-5.6-sol-medium`; escalate `claude-opus-5-thinking-high` on P0 contamination / user asks Opus. See `mock-bank-review-model.mdc`. Mechanical clean ≠ content OK. **Do not wait for the next live start** on the Wave template queue in `bank-audit-ledger.md`.

### 2) Our GEO / LLM visibility
- `exam-facts` + registry `examFactsKey` when applicable
- High-intent mock block + commercial deck cite in `exam-llm-layer` when the deck is live for sale
- Homepage + mock-index discovery links
- Money-page unique content for the deck slug
- `npm run llms:export` after cite/facts changes
- Focused tests for facts / llm-layer / launch as touched

### 3) Competitor SEO / GEO / AEO (no OpenRouter)
OpenRouter audits are **forbidden**. Use WebSearch + fetch of top SERP results only.

For the mock’s primary intents (e.g. `{exam} practice test`, `{exam} free mock`, `{exam} Anki`):

1. List top ~5 organic competitors (and any AI-overview / featured-snippet style targets if visible)
2. Compare against our `/mock-exams/{slug}` + `/decks/{deckSlug}`:
   - title / H1 / direct-answer first paragraph
   - official exam facts (Q count, time, pass score) accuracy
   - FAQ / schema / extractable Q&A
   - free timed mock vs paywall / lead-gate
   - Anki / flashcards CTA clarity
3. Output a short **beat / gap / ship** list and **fix gaps that are cheap and ours** in the same pass when possible

## Cadence (do not re-audit weekly)

Before layer 3 (competitor SERP), read `docs/mock-bank-qa/competitor-aeo-ledger.md`.
If last competitor AEO for that slug is **< 60 days**, skip SERP/cite rewrites — report “fresh until {date}”.
Full re-audit only at **≥ 60 days**, new/never-ledgered SKU, explicit user ask, or P0 official-facts drift.
See `.cursor/rules/competitor-aeo-cadence.mdc`.

## Speed
- One writer pass for the SKU that got traffic — do not mix unrelated certs
- Prefer local mechanical bank fixes; no OpenRouter enrich
- Commit/push only when the user asks to deploy / ship

docs.title: GEO / LLM Visibility
docs.text:
---
description: GEO/LLM visibility — canonical facts, shop previews, and mandatory verification before done
alwaysApply: true
---

# GEO / LLM Visibility

This project optimizes for GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), not classic Google SEO. The goal is to maximize accurate inclusion in LLM answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and similar systems.

When changing deck data, product naming, prices, checkout URLs, samples, categories, public copy, or visibility strategy:

- Think GEO first: prioritize extractable facts, direct answers, entity clarity, schema, citations, and machine-readable sources over keyword-stuffed SEO pages.
- Do not assume "more pages" is the right move. Add a page only when it gives LLMs a self-contained answer to a real user question, with useful Q&A passages and links to canonical facts.
- Keep canonical facts synchronized across `/api/facts`, `/api/facts/[slug]`, `/[slug].md`, `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, and product pages.
- Structure GEO content with question-like headings, 40-100 word atomic answer paragraphs, FAQPage/WebPage/Product schema where relevant, and concrete facts such as card counts, prices, checkout provider, format, and audience.
- Keep `/llms.txt` curated, not exhaustive: list high-signal product, intent, facts, markdown, and catalog URLs with one-line descriptions.
- Include `/llms-full.txt` in sitemap and link it from `/llms.txt` as the one-shot catalog bundle for agents.
- Ensure robots allow AI crawlers and that important GEO assets are crawlable without client-side interaction.
- Add or update tests that prove changed facts and visibility pages are exposed through LLM-visible sources, not only rendered visually.
- Preserve stable slugs unless the user explicitly asks to change URLs.
- Prefer consistent product titles that include exam/skill, "Anki Deck", card count, and product type.
- Position "English for [native language] Speakers" decks as IELTS / TOEFL preparation entry points for non-native English learners. Titles, direct answers, audience copy, FAQs, intent pages, and `/llms-full.txt` facts should connect them to IELTS vocabulary, TOEFL vocabulary, academic English, and exam readiness rather than generic English vocabulary only.

## Sample cards and audio (Prep2Go language decks)

- Never use shop **cover images** or pseudo-samples like "What is included in X?" when real preview cards exist on `prep2go.study/shop`.
- Source sample cards from `src/data/shop-preview-samples.json` + `public/shop-preview-media/` via `src/lib/prep2go-shop-samples.ts` — same data as `/shop/preview/{slug}` in the CIPLE/Prep2Go project.
- Each mapped Lemon deck must expose **3 real sample cards** with correct question/answer text, preview images, and audio URLs where the shop provides them.
- Phrase decks: audio is required; image may be absent (text-only preview is OK).
- Spanish + Italian paired deck: include both `audioUrlEs` and `audioUrlIt`.
- Grammar decks: use article visuals from `public/samples/prep2go-grammar/`.
- Finance/Gumroad decks: use actual Gumroad preview screenshots, not invented card text.
- Only products without shop previews (e.g. printable PDF) may fall back to a single cover sample.

## Mandatory verification before claiming LLM visibility is done

Do not say LLM/GEO work is complete until all of the following pass:

1. **Tests**: `npm test` green, including `prep2go-shop-samples.test.ts`, `llm-docs.test.ts`, and deck catalog tests.
2. **Catalog sync**: every `availableDecks` entry appears in `/api/facts`, `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, and its `/[slug].md` with matching title, price, card count, checkout URL, and sample cards.
3. **Sample integrity**: no deck with shop preview mapping has cover-only or placeholder samples; spot-check at least one IELTS/TOEFL deck, one citizenship deck, and one finance deck in `/api/facts/[slug]`.
4. **Intent pages**: language intent page lists all language decks and current IELTS/TOEFL positioning — not a stale subset.
5. **Production spot-check** (after deploy): curl or fetch `200` for `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, `/api/facts`, and changed `/api/facts/[slug]`; confirm sample `imageUrl`/`audioUrl` are absolute and load.
6. **Sitemap**: `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, all deck pages, and all `/*.md` documents are listed.

If any check fails, fix before deploy and re-verify.

docs.title: Mock bank audit standard (market-best)
docs.text:
---
description: Market-best mock bank audit standard — item quality, distractors, metric gates, Anki rebuild/republish cascade, selling-sample selection
alwaysApply: true
---

# Mock bank audit standard (market-best)

Goal: every live bank is the **best practice bank on the market** for its exam, not just "mechanically clean". Applies to every bank audit, rewrite, or point-fix (mock + linked Anki pair). Reviewer model: `mock-bank-review-model.mdc` (Sol default, Opus escalate, never Grok, never OpenRouter).

## 1. Process (every audit)

1. Export ops → git first if ops is newer (`export-ready-to-git.py --write <slug>`); audit the JSON users actually get.
2. Mechanical gates: `npm run triage:mock-banks -- --slug <slug>` (then `git checkout` the smell-board) + `npm run audit:bank-quality -- --slug <slug>`.
3. **Line-by-line content review of every item** (main chat or Sol/Opus subagent). Mechanical pass ≠ content OK.
4. Fix via `scripts/ops-mock-banks/manual-patches-*.json` → `enrich-banks.py` → `apply-enriched-banks.py --write` → `export-ready-to-git.py --write` → `check-live-runnable.ts` → `npx vitest run src/lib/mock-exams/`.
5. Re-run step 2 until **0 FAIL**; WARNs need a written reason or a fix.
6. Run the cascade (section 4) and samples (section 5). Log the result in `docs/mock-bank-qa/bank-audit-ledger.md`.

## 2. Item checklist (each question)

**Stem**: one unambiguous best answer; applied/scenario over bare "What is X?"; no boilerplate wrappers ("On the X Mock…", "Select the best answer"); no answer leak in the wording; NOT/EXCEPT used rarely and in capitals.

**Correct answer**: factually current (official outline, current rule numbers/limits/dates); same length, grammar and specificity as the distractors.

**Distractors** (where most banks fail):
- Plausible misconceptions a real candidate holds (confused sibling rule, wrong threshold, swapped party, right concept in the wrong context).
- Same domain, form, and length band as the key. No joke or absurd options ("Store the mixture for reuse tomorrow").
- No absolute-word giveaways ("always/never/only" on wrong options only); no "all/none of the above"; no two options that mean the same thing.
- Not copied from another item's correct answer verbatim; numeric options in order.

**Explanations**: the key explanation teaches the rule and why it applies (≥60 chars, not a restatement of the answer). Every distractor note names the specific error ("confuses X with Y", "that is the 30-day limit, not 15").

**Bank level**: covers every official content area in roughly blueprint weight, with ≥3 items per topic; varied difficulty; 0 duplicates or near-duplicate template families; session Q count / time / pass line honest vs the official exam on both mock and deck pages.

### Session / bank size (locked 2026-10-06 — we sell Mock Pass retakes)

Do **not** race OpenExamPrep/Career Employer on 200+ items. Product is timed diagnostic → weak topics → Anki, first mock free then $5 / 5 attempts.

| Type | Session | Unique bank floor | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wave / niche default | **60** (4×15) | **≥120** (min 90) | Selling 5 retakes of a 60-from-60 bank is a shuffle of the same stems |
| Money / official-adjacent | 75–120 when we can author it | ≥ **2× session** | SIE 75, PTCB/ServSafe 90, RD 120, Series 7 60 of 125 — always disclose vs official CAT/length |
| Quick diagnostic SKU | 25 | ≥75 | Must say diagnostic in title; not the only paid mock for a 100+ exam |

No `(Drill N)` copies toward the bank floor. Expand unique items in the same live-start pass when bank < floor. Do not silently stretch session to official CAT length without a real bank.

## 3. Metric gates (`npm run audit:bank-quality`)

FAIL (must be 0 or within limit): invalid key · duplicate or near-duplicate/templated stems · duplicate options · all/none of the above · missing / template / thin distractor notes (incl. "Not the best answer here; the right answer is …", **"This item asks" / "The matching answer is" Wave-3 pads**) · thin explanations · boilerplate stem wrappers ("On the X Mock…", "Select the best answer.", **"This X mock is:"**) · distractor copied from another item's correct answer > 5% · correct = longest option > 30% · correct >40% longer than every distractor > 10% · any key letter outside 15–35% (n ≥ 40).

**Wave template family is not "clean."** Banks still using "This item asks…" notes were a false mechanical pass until 2026-10-04. Do **not** wait for `mock:…:start` to rewrite them — Bing/Google already start those URLs. Remaining live template banks: `docs/mock-bank-qa/bank-audit-ledger.md` § Wave template pre-start queue.
WARN: absolute-word giveaways > 10% · short definition stems > 20% · NOT/EXCEPT > 10% · topic < 3 items.

## 4. Cascade after any bank correction (same pass, before "done")

| Linked deck source | Action |
|---|---|
| **Wave / building** (apkg built from the bank) | Rebuild the apkg in the canonical vault (`wave_deck_pipeline` / `building_deck_pipeline --deck-slug {slug}`) → `node scripts/replace-gumroad-apkg-files.mjs --slug {slug}` → `npm run check:gumroad-sample-cdn` → sync card count in `decks.ts` / specs if it changed |
| **Authored CSV** (FINRA SIE/7/63, CFA, FRM, PTCB, ServSafe: `internal_deck_generator/*/*_authored.csv`) | apkg does not change with the bank, but the deck is part of the same audit. Read every card; if it is below standard (label fronts like "Topic: X?", backs under ~120 chars, near-duplicate pairs, no example/mistake, domain mix off the official outline), **rewrite the CSV in the same pass** — never just flag it in the ledger. Keep old note GUIDs via a `Note GUID` column for 1:1 rewrites, rebuild the apkg, replace the Gumroad file, re-render samples, fix site/Gumroad copy that no longer matches the deck. Only skip when the user explicitly says so |
| **Civic / language** | Never rebuilt from a mock fix |

Always: refresh samples (section 5) · `npm run llms:export` · focused tests · Gumroad description or landing re-publish if samples or facts changed. Commit/push only on user OK; mock pages pick up ops within 1 h (ISR).

**Card-count honesty:** the advertised card count = unique cards. No `(Drill N)` copies or duplicate backs counted toward "300 cards". Padding is a P0: flag it to the user before shipping anything else on that SKU.

## 5. Selling samples: best quality, random among the best, selling

Picker: `src/lib/sample-pick.ts` (mock pages via `pickMockSampleQuestions`; decks via `npm run refresh:sold-samples -- --slug {deckSlug}`).

1. **Hard quality gate first**: no drills, templates, thin explanations, duplicate or absurd options, meta questions ("how many questions…"), bare definitions.
2. **Pool** = only items scoring ≥ 80% of the best (min 2× count).
3. **Random**: seeded shuffle (slug + pool content). Stable across renders, re-rolls only when the bank changes. Reviewer re-roll: `--salt N`.
4. **Diversity**: different topics/sections, no near-duplicate wording.
5. **Selling** = shows why we beat free banks: realistic scenario, a trap with a teaching note, a calculation or rule a candidate actually gets wrong. The reviewer confirms all 3 picks; any weak pick is re-rolled, never shipped.
6. **Deck samples are real cards from the shipped deck** (deck source, not mock MCQs, when the deck is authored separately).
7. **Text must match the image**: a `/samples/{slug}-sample-N.webp` is a capture of one card, and its site text, `/api/facts`, llms docs and Gumroad caption are that card's text. Never overlay other text on a screenshot (`applySoldSamplesToDeck` enforces this). To change samples (no user screenshots needed):
   1. `npm run refresh:sold-samples -- --slug {deckSlug}` (picks)
   2. `npm run render:sample-shots -- --slug {deckSlug}` → review the PNGs in `tmp/anki-shots/{slug}/` (renders the shipped `.apkg` card with its own template + CSS + MathJax in headless Chrome)
   3. same command with `--write --publish` → `public/samples/{slug}-sample-{1,2,3}.webp` + `decks.ts` sampleCards text from the same notes, then the Gumroad publisher for the deck type, then `check:gumroad-sample-cdn`:
      - finance catalog / `category: "finance"` (SIE, 7, 63, CFA, FRM…) → `publish-finance-gumroad-polish.mjs --refresh-samples`
      - wave live on Gumroad → `setup:gumroad-wave-decks --polish-only`
      - building live on Gumroad → `publish-building-gumroad-landings.py --force-cdn`
      - authored deck with a hand-built landing (PTCB, ServSafe Manager…) → `publish-authored-gumroad-samples.mjs`: keeps the rich landing/description, swaps only the `sample-cards` section + description figures, removes the old sample previews (never the main cover), backup in `tmp/gumroad-backups/`
      - planned (no Gumroad product) → nothing, site samples only
      New authored deck: add its `.apkg` to `AUTHORED_APKG` in `render-anki-sample-shots.mjs`. Unsure → `node scripts/publish-authored-gumroad-samples.mjs --slug {slug} --dry-run` first.
   4. Set the deck's `sold-samples.json` entry to the same 3 cards; update the deck test that pins sample questions.
   5. Focused tests (`decks.test.ts`, `apply-sold-samples.test.ts`).

# Mock bank content review (mandatory in pipeline)

Mechanical gates (`triage:mock-banks`, `validate:wave-deck`, `validate:certification`) do **not** catch wrong-credential remaps (e.g. CMA bank under medical-scribe). After writer READY — or on live `mock:…:start` when bank smell/remap risk is non-zero — run a **content-judgment** fix-first subagent.

## Model picker (cost + quality)

| Case | Model | Why |
|------|-------|-----|
| **Default** — new/rewritten bank after writer READY; routine wave ship; planned Anki pair | `gpt-5.6-sol-medium` | Cheaper; same house standard as Threads content review |
| **Escalate** — P0 contamination / sibling remap / finance-template distractors / first live start on never-ledgered SKU / user says Opus | `claude-opus-5-thinking-high` | Deeper fix-first when Sol would burn another full rewrite anyway |

**Never:** Grok for bank content. **Never:** OpenRouter `validate:mock-banks` as a substitute (forbidden — see `no-openrouter.mdc`).

**Sol/Opus not in the subagent list:** use parallel `inherit` subagents (same model as the main chat) for writing and review, split by topic/rows with a chunk validator — see `subagent-model-picker.mdc` § Parallel content work. The main chat merges, re-runs all gates and spot-reads before "done".

## What the reviewer must check

Full standard (item checklist, distractor rules, metric gates, Anki rebuild cascade, selling samples): **`mock-bank-audit-standard.mdc`**. Minimum:

- Credential match (stems say the right role: scribe ≠ CMA/CCMA, etc.)
- No sibling-remap leftovers (`remapped from sibling`, wrong exam body in prompts)
- No finance/FDIC template distractors; no empty/identical stems
- Explanations are real (not “The correct choice (…) matches this rule”)
- Session honesty vs official form (Q count / time / pass) on mock + deck pair
- Fix P0/P1 in-repo; do not commit/push unless user asked ship

## Handoff

Writer STOP (gate READY) → launch Sol (or Opus if escalate) → apply fixes → focused tests → user ship OK.

docs.title: UniPrep2Go SEO dual-track (live since 2026-08-27)
docs.text:
---
description: UniPrep2Go dual-track SEO — GSC wedge first (not catalog scale)
alwaysApply: true
---

# UniPrep2Go SEO dual-track (live since 2026-08-27)

**Canonical strategy:** `docs/SEO_AUTOPILOT_STRATEGY.md`  
**Supersedes:** FINRA-only weekly title allowlist (2026-08-06…08-13) while `sie-full-mock` stayed unknown.

## North star

US organic + LLM → free timed mock → topic readiness report → fix weak topics.  
**Anki/PDF = mechanism**, not the brand promise. Outcome = pass the exam / close diagnostic gaps.

## GSC reality (export 2026-09-24)

~1.5k page impr / 10 clicks / 90d — **distribution problem, not conversion.**  
Only ~26% of impr have query attribution. Do **not** invent winners from page-only positions.

**Four layers — do not collapse catalog size into “Google ignores the site.”**

| Layer | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Catalog | Live products / waitlists | `availableDecks` + mock configs |
| 2 SEO URL | Pages we *want* in Google | `sitemap.xml` (`shouldIndex*` + allowlist) |
| 3 Index | What Google actually indexed | URL Inspection / Page indexing report — **not** Performance CSV |
| 4 Performance | Impr / clicks / position | `npm run gsc:export` pages + query×page |

No-perf-row in GSC pages CSV ≠ not indexed (Inspection: MLT mock indexed, 0 impr). Sitewide quality is unproven until Coverage counts exist. Next audit: **Index → Performance → URL class**, not catalog count.

**Bing = lab, Google = scale.** On-site Bing mock:starts prove intent, not Bing rank. Do **not** open a second weekly title track for Bing, and do **not** rewrite a URL because a *different* SKU converted from Bing. Gold mine = same query×page Bing Webmaster pos 1–10 **and** GSC pos 30–100 — blocked until `tmp/bing-export-*` exists. IndexNow stays; pulse channel `bing` is measurement.

**Do not** noindex Bing-converting wave mocks to “shrink inventory.” That kills the lab. Thin state-RE outside CA/FL/TX/NY is already noindex.

**This week’s wedges (max 1–2 URLs):**

1. `/decks/series-63-anki-deck` ← attributed `series 63 flashcards`
2. `/decks/ptcb-study-guide-2026` ← attributed `ptcb outline 2026` (page pos~4 ≠ proven study-guide SERP)

**Keep · no scale:** DELF/CELI (real clicks), language catalog, AU Common Bond / CDL hazmat blogs.  
**Ignore pos:** LEED AP O+M `site:` junk queries.

## Exam tiers (Wave 1 — 2026-09-24)

| Tier | Scope | Action |
|------|--------|--------|
| **A** | PTCB, Series 63, CFA L2, Life & Health | Homepage + Layer B push + mock-result conversion |
| **A pilots** | EPA 608, ServSafe (live pairs) | Outcome CTAs only; **no new URLs** |
| **B** | Other live money (CFA L1, FRM, building, …) | Maintain; no weekly churn |
| **C** | Thin state RE, language churn, comics, new SKUs | Freeze |

Deepen-in-place on `/mock-exams/*` + `/decks/*` + `/blog/*`. Do **not** build `/exams/{slug}/` until Tier A proves demand.

## Operating model (90 days)

Dual-track — **not** weekly SIE/7/63 mock title churn:

1. **Layer A — Index:** force Google to know money URLs that are unknown / discovered / crawled-not-indexed **and** have 0 impressions. Cap ~8–10 Request indexing / week. Do **not** re-request pages that already have GSC impressions.
2. **Layer B — Push:** point-edit URLs already at **pos 8–25** into top 10. Max 1–2 URLs/week. One lever (title/meta/H1/directAnswer/FAQ + mock→deck CTA). Prefer GSC-attributed queries over hunches.
3. **Layer C — FINRA long game:** reopen SIE → 7 → 63 mock SEO **only when** `sie-full-mock` ≠ unknown **and** ≥10 impr/28d **and** Series 63 deck pos ≤8.

## Layer B allowlist (weekly)

- `/`
- `/decks/ptcb-study-guide-2026` ← **active wedge** (outline/blueprint)
- `/decks/series-63-anki-deck` ← **active wedge** (flashcards)
- `/decks/cfa-level-2-formula-reference-2026`
- `/blog/life-in-the-uk-test-why-one-in-three-fail`
- `/mock-exams/life-and-health-insurance-readiness-check`

Reserve: CA RE blog (pos 26–35), then `/mock-exams` hub.

## Homepage rule

Hero must feature **live Layer B money** (PTCB, CFA L2, Series 63, Life & Health) with **outcome-first** copy (weak topics / readiness), not Anki-as-H1. Do **not** billboard SIE as primary CTA while `sie-full-mock` is unknown to Google. SIE may stay a secondary link. Do not dump the full catalog into the first viewport.

## Freeze (keep live, no weekly SEO)

SIE / Series 7 / Series 63 **mock** title rewrites while SIE unknown · comics · survival/prep2go-app decks · new SKUs · building/LEED weekly · OpenRouter audits · competitor AEO if last pass < 60 days · thin state-RE scale · mass FAQ/blog · GEO catalog dump · `/exams/` URL migration.

## Always

- Crawled-not-indexed money URL → strengthen unique copy same turn (see `gsc-crawled-not-indexed-strengthen.mdc`).
- After content/cite change: focused tests + `npm run llms:export` when facts/cites change.
- Ship via `git push origin main` when user asks — no `vercel --prod` CLI.
- Re-export GSC: `npm run gsc:export` (includes query×page). Ledger: `tmp/gsc-export-*/QUERY_PAGE_ACTIONS.md`.

# Subagent model picker (set 2026-09-29)

Delegate work to Task subagents with an explicit model:

| Case | Model slug |
|---|---|
| **Default** — routine tasks (deck rebuilds, site sync, scripts, PDF builds, Gumroad ops, tests) | `composer-2.5-fast` |
| **Complex** — multi-file refactors, hard debugging, layout/rendering pipelines, anything Composer failed on | `grok-4.7-high-fast` |

User asked for "Composer 2.5 Standard" / "Grok Standard"; those are not in the subagent list — the slugs above are the closest available. If they appear later, switch to them.

## Grok limits (unchanged)

Grok is **never** used for:
- Threads review, bank copy, or content judgment (`threads-smart-agent-gpt-sol.mdc`)
- Mock / Anki bank content review (`mock-bank-review-model.mdc` — Sol default, Opus escalate)

If Sol/Opus are not available as a subagent model, use `inherit` subagents (same model as the main chat) for content writing and review — never fall back to Grok or Composer for content.

## Parallel content work (set 2026-10-02, user: «быстрее за счёт оптимизации, не жертвуя качеством»)

Bank / deck audits are split across **parallel `inherit` subagents** instead of one long main-chat pass:

- Main chat: gates → chunk inputs (`tmp/<slug>/…json`) + a chunk **validator** script → launch writers in one message (`run_in_background: true`) → while they run, do mechanical prep (pipeline, scripts) → merge → full gates → spot-read + fix → cascade.
- Split by topic / id range (bank, ~15–25 items per writer) and by row batch (deck, ~50–60 cards per writer). Give each writer: the standard, its coverage plan (no overlap between writers), key-letter quota, output path, and the validator command it must pass before returning.
- Mechanical steps with no content judgment (ops pipeline, apkg build, Gumroad replace/publish, sample render, tests) may go to `composer-2.5-fast`.
- Point-rewrite: only items/cards that fail the standard are rewritten; passing ones stay. Full rewrite only when most of the artifact fails.

## Always

- The main chat verifies subagent output (tests, live checks) before reporting done.
- Commit/push only when the user asks.

# Threads banks and review

Threads banks (UniPrep US, Prep2Go/CIPLE, Barakhlo, Emigro):

- **Do not rewrite a written bank** (`*days.json`, `*guides.json`, wizard, investment). No new 28/100-day replacement file while the live bank exists.
- **Adapt** only: point-edit weak rows. Input is farm HQ history + post ledger + `/engine` pipeline + pattern/adapt queue (views × weekday × hour × language × structure × tags × timers). Sol applies the patch; this agent does not write `p1`/`p2`.
- Farm engine (`threads_farm_engine.py`) is the mechanical knowledge core — best pipeline per account. Do not auto-rewrite banks from it.
- New SKU / new account with no bank yet: **`gpt-5.6-sol-medium`** writes the first bank.
- Review / best-model / fix-first: Task model **`gpt-5.6-sol-medium`** only.
- Never use Grok for Threads review, bank copy, or content judgment.
- Live farm on the VPS is write-locked (`/opt/farm-lock`). Do not rsync or unlock farm files from this UniPrep repo. Unlock only from the farm HQ chat that created the lock.
- **Warn, don’t decide:** anything that might hurt reach, trust, measurement honesty, brand, or funnel (mismatched image/text, skipped answers, sparse dest while bio link dies, volume spikes on weak accounts, observe-only experiment arms, language mismatch, overlapping tests on one handle) — flag to the user first and wait for OK. Do not ship “good enough” shortcuts that confound a live experiment.

docs.title: Add Certification (UniPrep2Go)
docs.text:
---
name: add-certification
description: >-
  End-to-end UniPrep2Go certification pipeline — mock exam, Anki deck, site funnel,
  SEO, GEO/LLM, Gumroad product, covers, bank generation/validation, .apkg export,
  publish, and production deploy. Use when the user names a new certification, exam,
  credential, or asks for a full under-key pathway (мок, анки, сайт, SEO, воронка,
  LLM, Gumroad, картинки, полный пайплайн).
---

# Add Certification (UniPrep2Go)

**Under-key default:** when the user names a certification, run the **full pipeline** below without asking permission for each step. Orchestrate with subagents for bank gen, validation, apkg, and Gumroad when useful; parent agent validates gates and deploys.

## Fast ship handoff (mandatory — do not stretch)

User cadence (keep ACE-style ships under one writer pass + one review):

| Phase | Who | Exit |
|-------|-----|------|
| **A. Write** | Parent agent | Bank expand **once** → apkg **once** → Gumroad → SEO/GEO → focused tests → gate READY → **STOP** |
| **B. Bank review** | Fix-first: default **`gpt-5.6-sol-medium`**; escalate **`claude-opus-5-thinking-high`** on P0 remap / first live never-ledgered / user asks Opus. Never Grok. Rule: `mock-bank-review-model.mdc` | P0/P1 fixed; **no** second full bank rewrite unless content P0 |
| **C. Screenshots** | User | Drop 3 Anki captures → agent converts to `public/samples/{deckSlug}-sample-{1,2,3}.webp` |
| **D. Publish** | Parent after user OK | commit + push `main` (Vercel) |

**Speed killers (forbidden):**
- Mixing unrelated audits into the active SKU ship
- Regenerating bank/apkg/assets in a loop before review
- Inventing blank/identical sample webps
- Skipping the gate script for the correct path (building vs wave)
- Polishing for hours after gate READY instead of handing to review

## Path picker (building vs wave)

| Path | When | Spec | Gumroad | Gate |
|------|------|------|---------|------|
| **Building** | HVAC/LEED/MRICS-style registry certs | `building-deck-specs.json` + `certifications/registry.json` | `setup:gumroad-building-decks` | `npm run validate:certification -- --deck {deckSlug}` |
| **Wave** | Health/CDL/niche (ACE CPT, NASM, …) | `wave-deck-specs.json` + `wave-anki-decks.json` | `setup:gumroad-wave-decks` | `npm run validate:wave-deck -- --slug {deckSlug}` |

Wave apkg:

```bash
cd "/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/Anki Generator"
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m internal_deck_generator.py.wave_deck_pipeline \
  --deck-slug {deckSlug} \
  --uniprep2go-root "/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/uniprep2go"
```

Force-launch non-money wave cohorts via `WAVE_FORCE_LAUNCH_SLUGS` in `anki-deck-launch.ts`.

## What the user provides

**Required**
- Certification / exam name (e.g. "Digital SAT", "WELL AP", "EPA 608", "ACE CPT")

**Optional (agent researches if missing)**
- Exam body, official format, scoring axes, topic domains, price override, audience

**User-only asset (do not invent as final product art)**
- **Sample card screenshots** (`public/samples/{deckSlug}-sample-{1,2,3}.webp`) — wait for user captures. Until then use cover; **never** blank/identical synthetic webps as “samples.”

**Do not create mocks for `language` category decks** (DELF, CIPLE, DELE, etc.). Language = Anki-only.

## Reference implementations

| Pattern | Use when |
|---------|----------|
| **Digital SAT** (`sat-readiness-check` / `sat-anki-deck`) | Academic admissions; official **section axes** (not arbitrary 4–8 topics); oversized sale bank + sampled session; `requireAllTopicsAtTarget` |
| **GMAT Focus** | Multi-section academic readiness; large bank; preview→live after QA |
| **EPA 608** | Professional building/HVAC; 4 domain topics; registry building line |

## Auth (never “lose” tokens)

| Secret | Resolution |
|--------|------------|
| Gumroad | `scripts/lib/gumroad-auth.mjs` → `.env.local` → `~/.config/gumroad` → `gumroad auth token` (auto-persist to `.env.local`) |
| OpenRouter | `scripts/lib/openrouter.mjs` loads `.env.local`, then sibling projects (`CIPLE A2/ciple-master/.env.local`, Anki Generator). **Persist** into uniprep2go `.env.local` when found elsewhere |

Do not stop because `GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN` / `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` are missing from process.env — resolve and sync first.

## Scoring axes rule

**Look up how the real exam is scored**, then map mock `topics` to those axes:

- Digital SAT → **2** section scores (Reading and Writing, Math), not 8 content domains as pass axes
- GMAT Focus → **3** sections (Quant, Verbal, Data Insights)
- EPA 608 → Core + Types I–III

If overall % can pass while a scored section fails, set `passRule.requireAllTopicsAtTarget: true` (SAT pattern).

## Bank sizing

| Layer | Size |
|-------|------|
| Timed session | `sum(topic.questionCount)` (e.g. SAT 27+22=49) |
| Sale / Anki bank | User target or default **~50/topic** via **local** `scripts/expand-*-bank-local.py` only (never OpenRouter for bank authoring) |
| After LLM validate `--apply` | Sync `ankiDeckCardCount`, `building-deck-specs.json` `cardCount` / `gumroadName`, deck copy, SEO titles |

Live mocks may have banks **larger than** session size. Runnable rules use `>=` topic quotas (`question-bank.ts`). Validator accepts `--slug` for live registry banks.

## Pipeline (execute in order — do not skip)

### 0. Spec + registry

```bash
# Fill scripts/templates/{id}.spec.json from certification.spec.json
npm run scaffold:certification -- --spec scripts/templates/{id}.spec.json
```

Slugs: `mockSlug` = `{kebab}-readiness-check`, `deckSlug` = `{kebab}-anki-deck`, `gumroadPermalink` ≈ `deckSlug`.

Also add entry to:
- `src/data/building-deck-specs.json` (apkg metadata: `filePrefix`, `cardCount`, `topics`, `gumroadName`)
- Cluster map in `src/lib/building-cert-clusters.ts` when it is a new pathway group

### 1. Mock exam

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/mock-exams/configs.ts` | topics = **official score axes**, session counts, weights sum 100, `passRule`, `linkedDeckSlug`, start `status: "preview"`, `ankiDeckCardCount`, disclaimer |
| `src/lib/mock-exams/seo.ts` | Full SEO profile |
| `src/lib/mock-exams/question-bank.ts` | Import + `banksBySlug` |
| `src/data/mock-exams/{mockSlug}.json` | `[]` then fill |

### 2. Anki deck + catalog

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/decks.ts` | `status: "planned"`, topicCoverage, faqs, `coverImage`, `sampleCards` paths (even if images pending) |
| `src/data/gumroad/building-anki-decks.json` | `{ permalink, gumroadProductId: null }` |
| `src/data/catalog-list-prices.json` | Explicit override (building default USD **11** unless product differs) |
| `src/data/building-deck-specs.json` | Spec for apkg export |

Launch layer (`anki-deck-launch.ts`) flips planned → available when Gumroad permalink exists.

### 3. Site funnel

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| Deck page | Auto via `linkedDeckSlug` |
| `src/app/page.tsx` | Discovery / repair link |
| `src/app/mock-exams/page.tsx` | Cluster / priority list |
| Hub pages | `finance-anki-decks` / building hub as relevant |

### 4. SEO / indexation

- Start `preview` → `noindex` until bank runnable
- After bank QA + validation: set `status: "live"` so `shouldIndexMockExam` indexes
- Deck SEO profile in `src/lib/deck-seo.ts` when framing is non-default

### 5. LLM / GEO (same writer pass — before review)

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/exam-facts.ts` | Profile + `deckExamKeyMap` (required for academic/high-intent / money SKUs) |
| `src/lib/exam-llm-layer.ts` | Commercial high-intent cite (curated `/llms.txt`) **and/or** `HIGH_INTENT_MOCK_BLOCKS` |
| `src/lib/llm-docs.ts` | Citation one-liner + top citation query when commercial |
| `src/lib/deck-money-page-content.ts` | Pitch + unique content for money pages |
| `public/llms.txt` | `npm run llms:export` before STOP for review |

Note: `HIGH_INTENT_MOCK_BLOCKS` alone may be truncated by `buildExamHighIntentSection(12)`. Money SKUs need the **commercial** section to appear in curated `/llms.txt`.

### 6. Covers + Gumroad thumbnail (agent-owned)

```bash
# DECK_CONFIGS entry in scripts/generate-deck-covers.mjs first
npm run generate:deck-covers -- --slug {deckSlug}
npm run generate:deck-covers -- --gumroad-thumbnails --slug {deckSlug}
```

### 7. Bank generation (ALWAYS LOCAL — never OpenRouter)

**Hard rule:** mock question banks are generated **only with local expand scripts**. Do **not** call `npm run generate:mock-banks` / OpenRouter for bank authoring.

```bash
# Pattern: scripts/expand-{id}-bank-local.py (see expand-sat-bank-local.py / expand-gmat-bank-local.py)
python3 scripts/expand-{id}-bank-local.py
# Writes src/data/mock-exams/{mockSlug}.json + .generation-cache/{mockSlug}/
```

If no expand script exists for the cert yet, **create one** (template factories + seeded RNG), then run it. OpenRouter bank generation is forbidden for this pipeline.

### 8. Bank validation (mandatory — local + content review)

**Mechanical (always):**
```bash
npm run triage:mock-banks -- --slug {mockSlug}
# then the path gate: validate:wave-deck or validate:certification
```

**Content review (always after READY):** launch fix-first Task — default **`gpt-5.6-sol-medium`**; escalate **`claude-opus-5-thinking-high`** on P0 remap / first live never-ledgered / user asks Opus. Never Grok. Never OpenRouter `validate:mock-banks` (forbidden — `no-openrouter.mdc`). Details: `.cursor/rules/mock-bank-review-model.mdc`.

Then sync all **card count** strings/specs if the reviewer dropped/rewrote items. Re-run session/topic quota tests.

### 9. Promote to live

When bank runnable + validation report exists:
1. `status: "live"` in mock config
2. Confirm `isMockExamRunnable(mockSlug) === true`
3. Confirm `shouldIndexMockExam(mockSlug) === true`

### 10. .apkg export (Anki Generator) — once per writer pass

**Canonical vault only:** `/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/Anki Generator` (sibling of `uniprep2go`). Never `CIPLE A2/Anki Generator` or `--out=../Anki Generator` from `ciple-master`.

```bash
cd "/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/Anki Generator"
# Building:
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m internal_deck_generator.py.building_deck_pipeline \
  --deck-slug {deckSlug} --uniprep2go-root "/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/uniprep2go"
# Wave:
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m internal_deck_generator.py.wave_deck_pipeline \
  --deck-slug {deckSlug} --uniprep2go-root "/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/uniprep2go"
```

### 11. Gumroad create + assets + publish

**Hard rule:** every Gumroad product must have rich description + 3 sample screenshots. Never leave cover-only / one-line copy.

```bash
cd uniprep2go
# Building:
npm run setup:gumroad-building-decks -- --slug {deckSlug}
python3 scripts/polish-building-gumroad.py --slug {deckSlug}
python3 scripts/publish-building-gumroad-landings.py --slug {deckSlug}
# Wave:
npm run setup:gumroad-wave-decks -- --slug {deckSlug}
# After user sample screenshots land:
npm run setup:gumroad-wave-decks -- --slug {deckSlug} --polish-only
# Later apkg refresh (also re-polishes description + samples):
npm run setup:gumroad-wave-decks -- --slug {deckSlug} --assets-only
```

Catalog must end with non-null `gumroadProductId`, `shortUrl`, `apkgUploadedAt`, `publishedAt`, and for wave: `descriptionPolishedAt` + `samplesUploadedAt`.

### 12. Sample screenshots (USER — phase C) — site + Gumroad body

Paths: `public/samples/{deckSlug}-sample-1.webp` … `-sample-3.webp`

Agent:
1. Wire `sampleCards[].imageUrl` paths early
2. **STOP for user captures** — do not fabricate blank webps
3. On drop: convert/resize (~701×1024 WebP), replace, sync `sampleCards` copy to match the 3 cards
4. **Mandatory Gumroad body update** (not site-only):
   ```bash
   npm run setup:gumroad-wave-decks -- --slug {deckSlug} --polish-only
   ```
   This sets rich description, uploads gallery previews, **and** publishes a custom Gumroad landing with **Sample cards** images in the product body (`publish-wave-gumroad-landings.py`). Building path: `publish-building-gumroad-landings.py`.
5. Do **not** block initial Gumroad create waiting for screenshots — swap in phase C, but Phase C is incomplete until polish-only + landing succeed

### 13. Gates + tests → review → deploy

```bash
# Building:
npm run validate:certification -- --deck {deckSlug}
# Wave:
npm run validate:wave-deck -- --slug {deckSlug}

npx vitest run src/lib/anki-deck-launch.test.ts src/lib/exam-facts.test.ts src/lib/llm-docs.test.ts
npm run llms:export
# STOP → launch best-model fix-first review
# After review + user screenshots + user OK:
git add … && git commit && git push origin main
```

**Do not claim done** until the correct gate has zero blocking failures, Gumroad has apkg, GEO cites exist for money SKUs, and user has OK’d publish (screenshots swapped or explicitly deferred).

## Definition of done

- [ ] Registry + mock + SEO + bank import
- [ ] Deck + gumroad catalog + list price + building-deck-specs
- [ ] Cover + Gumroad thumbnail
- [ ] Funnel + homepage + mock index + exam-facts + HIGH_INTENT
- [ ] Bank generated, LLM-validated, counts synced
- [ ] Mock `live` + indexable
- [ ] `.apkg` built and uploaded; Gumroad published
- [ ] `validate:certification` READY
- [ ] Pushed to `main` (prod)
- [ ] Sample screenshots: user-provided (or noted as pending swap)

## Gate reference

Blocking: mock-config, mock-seo, deck-catalog, gumroad-catalog, mock-bank, mock-bank-import, cover-image, cover-config, funnel-link, exam-facts (when `examFactsKey` set)

Warnings: gumroad-live, mock-validation, llm-high-intent, homepage-links, mock-index-links

## npm scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `scaffold:certification` | Registry + checklist (building) |
| `validate:certification` | Blocking gates (building) |
| `validate:wave-deck` | Blocking gates (wave / ACE / niche) |
| `expand-*-bank-local.py` | **Local** bank gen (required) |
| `generate:mock-banks` | ❌ Do not use for banks |
| `triage:mock-banks` | Mechanical smells (always) |
| Bank content review | Task `gpt-5.6-sol-medium` default / Opus escalate — see `mock-bank-review-model.mdc` |
| `validate:mock-banks` | ❌ Do not use (OpenRouter) |
| `generate:deck-covers` | Cover + `--gumroad-thumbnails` |
| `setup:gumroad-building-decks` | Building Gumroad |
| `setup:gumroad-wave-decks` | Wave Gumroad |
| `llms:export` | Refresh `public/llms.txt` |

## Orchestration tips

- Parallelize: **local** bank expand ‖ cover gen ‖ wire-up; then validate → apkg → Gumroad → deploy
- Never start OpenRouter bank generation even if a key is present
- Parent agent always re-runs `validate:certification` after subagents
- Never commit `scripts/local-banks/`, `scripts/*-bank-data/`, or raw OpenRouter keys
- Keep `.env.local` out of git; persist tokens there for the next run

## Additional resources

- Registry: [src/data/certifications/registry.json](../../src/data/certifications/registry.json)
- Spec template: [scripts/templates/certification.spec.json](../../scripts/templates/certification.spec.json)
- SAT reference spec: [scripts/templates/sat.spec.json](../../scripts/templates/sat.spec.json)
- Gumroad auth: [scripts/lib/gumroad-auth.mjs](../../scripts/lib/gumroad-auth.mjs)
- OpenRouter: [scripts/lib/openrouter.mjs](../../scripts/lib/openrouter.mjs)
- LLM rules: [.cursor/rules/llm-visibility.mdc](../../.cursor/rules/llm-visibility.mdc)

# UniPrep2Go

Minimal LLM-readable landing page for CFA Anki decks.

## Getting Started

Install dependencies and run the development server:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

## Product Catalog

Deck data lives in `src/lib/decks.ts`. Add future decks by adding new records to the `decks` array.

## Funnel Logging

The landing page logs funnel events to `/api/events`:

- `page_view`
- `product_facts_view`
- `topic_matrix_view`
- `catalog_view`
- `faq_view`
- `checkout_intent`
- `gumroad_click`

For the MVP, events are stored in memory and written to server logs as `[funnel_event]`. Use persistent storage before relying on this for long-running production analytics.

## Telegram Stats Bot

Set the bot token as an environment variable:

```bash
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=replace-with-token-from-botfather
```

Do not commit bot tokens. If a token has been pasted into chat or logs, rotate it in BotFather before production use.

After deployment, point the bot webhook to:

```bash
https://api.telegram.org/bot$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/setWebhook?url=https://uniprep2go.study/api/telegram
```

Then send `/stats` or `stats` to the bot to receive the current funnel summary.

## Verification

```bash
npm test
npm run lint
npm run build
```

docs.text:
# Бэклог UniPrep2Go

Приоритизированный список задач по продукту, сайту и каталогу колод.

Обновлено: 2026-07-15

---

## 🎯 Следующие экзамены (roadmap расширения каталога)

**Критерий отбора:** дополняет уже существующий кластер, хорошо ложится на pipeline **mock → deck → Gumroad**, даёт **MCQ / recall**, а не essay-only.

### Что уже есть (baseline)

| Кластер | Экзамены |
|---------|----------|
| **Building / sustainability** | EPA 608, BMS, LEED GA, LEED AP BD+C, WELL AP, CEM, ASHRAE, CDCP, NEBOSH, CFPS, MRICS APC, MRICS QS |
| **MBA** | GMAT Focus |
| **Finance (US)** | SIE, Series 7, Series 63, CFA L1, CFA L2, FRM Part 1 |
| **US licensing** | Insurance L&H, Insurance P&C, CA Real Estate, ServSafe, PTCB |
| **Language** | 22+ Prep2Go decks |

**Инфраструктура:** registry → mock bank → validation → Anki `.apkg` → Gumroad → `/decks` + `/mock-exams` + hub `/building-certification-anki-decks`.

---

### Tier 1 — максимально логично (дополняет live-кластеры)

#### Green building / LEED pathway

| Экзамен | Зачем | Кластер |
|---------|-------|---------|
| **LEED AP O+M** | Естественный шаг после BD+C; та же аудитория USGBC | `green-building` |
| **LEED AP ID+C** | Интерьеры, дизайнеры рядом с WELL AP | `green-building` |
| **CMVP** (AEE) | Пара к CEM — measurement & verification | `green-building` / AEE |
| **SITES AP** или **ENV SP** | Расширение sustainability без нового домена | `green-building` |

#### Facility / HVAC / energy

| Экзамен | Зачем | Кластер |
|---------|-------|---------|
| **CMVP**, **REP** (AEE) | CEM уже есть — та же экосистема AEE | `green-building` / AEE |
| **NATE** (HVAC tech) | Аудитория EPA 608 + BMS, другой угол | `hvac-controls` |
| **IFMA CFM / FMP** | Facility managers после BMS/CEM | `hvac-controls` |

#### Data centre

| Экзамен | Зачем | Кластер |
|---------|-------|---------|
| **DCDC** (EPI advanced) | Upsell после CDCP | `datacenter` |
| **CTDC** (Uptime) | Конкурирующий стандарт, тот же ICP | `datacenter` |

#### Safety / fire (рядом с NEBOSH + CFPS)

| Экзамен | Зачем | Кластер |
|---------|-------|---------|
| **CSP** (BCSP) | US safety pro, complement NEBOSH | `safety-fire` |
| **CHST / ASP** | Construction safety, OSHA-adjacent | `safety-fire` |
| **OSHA 30-Hour** (Construction / General) | Огромный спрос, MCQ-friendly summary deck | `safety-fire` |

#### Construction / PM (рядом с MRICS)

| Экзамен | Зачем | Кластер |
|---------|-------|---------|
| **PMP** (PMI) | Универсальный; QS/APC кандидаты часто идут параллельно | `construction-surveying` |
| **CCM** (CMAA) | Construction management, US counterpart MRICS | `construction-surveying` |
| **CCS / CCP** (AACE) | Cost/controls — близко MRICS QS | `construction-surveying` |

#### MBA / grad (рядом с GMAT)

| Экзамен | Зачем | Кластер |
|---------|-------|---------|
| **GRE General** | Тот же pipeline (Quant + Verbal + формулы) | `mba-admissions` |
| **EA** (Executive Assessment) | Короткий MBA diagnostic, меньше конкуренции | `mba-admissions` |

**Рекомендуемый порядок Tier 1:** LEED AP O+M → GRE → PMP → CMVP → DCDC.

---

### Tier 2 — US licensing (сайт US-first)

| Экзамен | Зачем | Примечание |
|---------|-------|------------|
| **Series 65 / 66** | Логичное продолжение SIE → 7 → 63 | Finance cluster |
| **Series 24** | Principal / supervisor track | Finance cluster |
| **Real estate — FL, TX, NY** | CA уже есть; multi-state SEO | US licensing |

---

### Tier 3 — finance (расширение CFA/FRM)

| Экзамен | Зачем |
|---------|-------|
| **CFA Level 3** | L1/L2 уже есть |
| **CAIA Level 1** | Alternatives, overlap с CFA alt investments |
| **SCR** (Sustainability & Climate Risk) | CFA Institute + green building audience |

---

### Tier 4 — сильный спрос, но другой формат / сложнее

| Экзамен | Комментарий |
|---------|-------------|
| **ARE 5.0** (архитектор US) | 6 divisions — лучше по одному division или overview deck |
| **PE / FE** (NCEES) | Большой рынок, много формул — как GMAT, но шире |
| **NCIDQ** | Дизайн интерьеров, рядом WELL / LEED ID+C |
| **LSAT / MCAT** | Огромный TAM, но другая команда контента |

---

### Практичный порядок запуска (3 волны)

```
Волна A — quick wins (без нового deck content)
  1. ~~PTCB readiness mock → привязка к существующему deck~~ ✅ (2026-07-15)
  2. Homepage / hub cross-links для новых кластеров (сделано для building)

Волна B — Tier 1 cluster extensions
  3. LEED AP O+M          (green-building)
  4. GRE General          (mba-admissions, клон GMAT pipeline)
  5. PMP                  (construction-surveying)
  6. CMVP                 (green-building / AEE)
  7. DCDC                 (datacenter upsell)

Волна C — US licensing + finance depth
  8. Series 65/66
  9. CFA L3 / CAIA L1
  10. Real estate FL/TX/NY
```

**Оценка объёма bank на экзамен:** 4–5 topics × 50 Q = 200–250 MCQ в bank; session subsample по конфигу mock (как GMAT 45 из 200).

---

## 🔥 Сейчас (High Priority)

### Монетизация — быстрые победы

- [ ] **Поднять цену CFA Level 1 с $11 до $14–15**
  - Контекст: Etsy-конкуренты с меньшим числом отзывов берут $15.60–$24
  - Действие: обновить цену на Gumroad + `src/lib/decks.ts` + JSON-LD на странице
  - Риск: низкий; текущая конверсия 4.8% даёт запас для теста

- [x] **Добавить на сайт оставшиеся Gumroad-колоды (commodities)** — Oil (`ugngbd`), Coal (`ipnqky`), 3-in-1 bundle (`tzzgh`); Metal уже был

- [x] **Sample cards для колод без превью** — скриншоты карточек с Gumroad (7 колод; CIPLE A2 и German A2 — на Gumroad нет card preview)

---

## 🚀 Следующие продукты (по результатам market research)

- [x] FRM Part 1 Anki Deck — live
- [x] CFA Level 2 Anki Deck — live
- [x] CFA L1 Formula Reference PDF — live

---

## 📦 Готовые колоды на диске — к публикации

Источник: `/Users/pavelveselov/Projects/Anki Generator/out/`

Критерий качества: 1000 cards + 2000 media (audio + images).

## 📈 Сайт и LLM visibility

### Building certification line — shipped (2026-07)

---

## ✅ Сделано

# Press & listicle outreach — UniPrep2Go

**Live kit:** https://www.uniprep2go.study/press  
**Product:** https://www.uniprep2go.study  
**Email:** support@uniprep2go.study (subject: `Press / citation`)

## What shipped

| Asset | Location |
|-------|----------|
| Public citation kit | `src/app/press/page.tsx` → `/press` |
| Republication license | On `/press` |
| 2 Top-5 blurbs | free SIE mock · citizenship Anki |
| LLM discovery | `/llms.txt` · `public/llms.txt` |

## Weekly outreach loop

Hi [Name],

I saw your piece ([URL]) still ranks for [query] — and AI answers often cite it.
